Usage: gacli skills uninstall [options]

Remove a previously installed gacli skill

Options:
  --agent <agent>  Target agent: claude, codex, qwen, gemini, or all
  --scope <scope>  Scope: user, project, or a custom path (default: "user")
  --name <name>    Skill directory name (default: "gacli")
  --all            Uninstall every detected gacli install across all agents and
                   scopes
  --dry-run        Show what would happen without removing anything
  -h, --help       display help for command
